result.instructions: Tools for Jisr, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who joined the company this month?"; "Show last month's attendance summary: who was late or absent the most?"; "What are the annual leave balances for employees 101, 102 and 103?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jisr data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jisr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jisr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jisr_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. jisr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jisr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the organization's employees (active by default) with code, names (English/Arabic), job title, department, business unit, employment type, line manager, joining date and status. Filter by active/inactive status, creation date and joining, termination or deletion date ranges. If the API key also has the 'Get Employee Financial Info' / 'Accounting Info' permissions, Jisr adds salary, bank (IBAN) and accounting fields: sensitive HR data. GET /openapi/v1/employees.

status.description: Only active or only inactive employees.

created_from.description: Only employees created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

joining_from.description: Only employees who joined on or after this date.

joining_to.description: Only employees who joined on or before this date.

terminated_from.description: Only employees off-boarded on or after this date.

terminated_to.description: Only employees off-boarded on or before this date.

deleted_from.description: Only employees deleted from the system on or after this date.

deleted_to.description: Only employees deleted from the system on or before this date.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

rpp.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `rpp`.

tools.name: jisr_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee's profile by id (UUID from jisr_list_employees): names, code, gender, marital status, phone, emails, date of birth, passport/ID number, address, line manager, department, business unit, employment type, location, nationality and contract. GET /openapi/v1/employees/basic_info?id=.

tools.name: jisr_get_employee_financial_info
tools.title: Get employee financial info
tools.description: One employee's financial details by id: salary components and bank account (IBAN). Sensitive payroll data; needs the 'Get Employee Financial Info' permission on the API key. GET /openapi/v1/employees/financial_info?id=.

tools.name: jisr_list_lookup
tools.title: List lookup values
tools.description: List one of the organization's lookup tables: departments, employment_types, business_units, locations, nationalities or outsourcing_companies, with their ids and English/Arabic names. Use the ids when creating an employee. GET /openapi/v1/lookups/{table}.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

rpp.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `rpp`.

tools.name: jisr_list_attendance_summary
tools.title: List attendance summary
tools.description: Attendance summary per employee for a date range (default: the current month): total working hours, late arrival, early departure, extra and approved overtime, absence days and records. Filter by one employee or by active/inactive status. GET /openapi/v1/attendance/summary.

from.description: Period start (yyyy-mm-dd). Default: start of the current month.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

rpp.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `rpp`.

tools.name: jisr_list_attendance_punches
tools.title: List attendance punches
tools.description: List raw clock-in/out punches that were received from punch devices, either the ones that were processed successfully or the ones that failed, in a time window (Jisr's default: the last hour). Each punch has id, punch_time, employee_code, terminal_sn and clocking_id. GET /openapi/v1/attendance_logs.

status.description: Which punches: processed successfully, or failed.

from.description: Window start, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss. Default: one hour ago.

to.description: Window end, yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss. Default: now.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `limit`.

tools.name: jisr_get_annual_leave_balances
tools.title: Get annual leave balances
tools.description: Annual leave balance summaries per employee (all employees, or only the given employee codes, at most 100). Only the annual leave type is supported by Jisr. GET /openapi/v1/employee_leaves/summary.

employee_codes.description: Employee codes (not ids) to include; omit for everyone.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `limit`.

tools.name: jisr_list_paygroups
tools.title: List pay groups
tools.description: List the organization's pay groups (id and name). The pay group id is needed for payroll and accrual queries. GET /openapi/v1/paygroups.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

rpp.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `rpp`.

tools.name: jisr_list_payroll_transactions
tools.title: List payroll transactions
tools.description: Payroll transactions per employee for one settlement type. type 'payrun' (the regular payroll) needs pay_period and paygroup_id; 'final_settlements', 'vacations_settlements' and 'out_off_payroll_transactions' need a from/to date range. Optionally filter by employee ids or transaction type ids (jisr_list_gl_transaction_types). Sensitive payroll data. GET /openapi/v1/payroll_transactions.

pay_period.description: First day of a confirmed month (yyyy-mm-01). Required for type payrun.

paygroup_id.description: Pay group id (UUID, jisr_list_paygroups). Required for type payrun.

from.description: Start date (yyyy-mm-dd). Required for the other types.

to.description: End date (yyyy-mm-dd). Required for the other types.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

rpp.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `rpp`.

tools.name: jisr_list_accrual_transactions
tools.title: List accrual transactions
tools.description: Accruals per employee for a confirmed pay period: vacations, end_of_service or tickets_provision (amount, vacation days). Sensitive payroll data. GET /openapi/v1/accrual_transactions.

pay_period.description: First day of a confirmed month (yyyy-mm-01).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

rpp.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `rpp`.

tools.name: jisr_get_employee_monthly_payables
tools.title: Get employee monthly payables
tools.description: One employee's payables for a month: net salary, earnings, additions and deductions with breakdowns. Only available to organizations Jisr has whitelisted for this API. Sensitive payroll data. GET /openapi/v1/employee_monthly_payables.

tools.name: jisr_list_gl_transaction_types
tools.title: List transaction types
tools.description: List the payroll (GL) transaction types: id, category (allowances, loan types...), English/Arabic name and status. Use the ids to filter jisr_list_payroll_transactions. GET /openapi/v1/gl_transaction_types.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

rpp.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `rpp`.

tools.name: jisr_list_audit_events
tools.title: List audit events
tools.description: The organization's audit trail: who did what and when (module, feature, action, actor, success). Filter by module, event name, event type and a time range. GET /openapi/v1/audit_events.

from.description: Only events created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

to.description: Only events created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jisr's default is 100). Sent as `per_page`.

tools.name: jisr_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for the organization: name, endpoint host, method, status. Authentication data, custom header values and the endpoint's path and query (they can hold secrets) are hidden. Read-only; this server does not create or change webhooks. GET /openapi/v1/webhooks.

tools.name: jisr_create_employee
tools.title: Create employee
tools.description: WRITE: register a new employee in Jisr (they are invited to the system by email). Not reversible through this server: there is no delete tool. Get department_id, employment_type_id, location_id and nationality_id from jisr_list_lookup first. Names need at least two parts. POST /openapi/v1/employees.

code.description: Employee code, unique within the organization.

full_name_en.description: Full name in English (at least two words).

full_name_ar.description: Full name in Arabic (at least two words).

outsourcing_company_id.description: Outsourcing company id, for outsourced staff.

contract_end_date.description: Contract end date (yyyy-mm-dd), for fixed-term contracts.

tools.name: jisr_create_attendance_punches
tools.title: Import attendance punches
tools.description: WRITE: send a batch of raw clock-in/out punches (at most 100) from a punch device into Jisr attendance. Jisr processes them asynchronously; check the result with jisr_list_attendance_punches. Each punch carries the unique id its device generated; do not invent ids. POST /openapi/v1/attendance_logs.

id.description: Unique punch id generated by the device.

terminal_sn.description: Serial number / id of the punch device.

emp_code.description: Employee code (a string, also for numeric codes).

punch_time.description: When the punch happened, yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss in the organization's local time.
